<h2 title="Class AddressQuery" class="title">Class AddressQuery</h2>
</div>
<div class="contentContainer">
<ul class="inheritance">

<div class="description">
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<hr>
<pre>public final class <span class="typeNameLabel">AddressQuery</span>
extends java.lang.Object</pre>
<div class="block"><p>The options to specify an address query. A <a href="#query"><code>query</code></a> can consist of parts of an address or full addresses,
 optionally comma separated. <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-addressquery" title="class in com.here.sdk.search"><code>AddressQuery</code></a> should only be used to search for parts of the address,
 excluding the POI name. For example, &quot;Invalidenstraße 116, Berlin, Germany&quot; is appropriate, whereas
 &quot;HERE, Invalidenstraße 116, Berlin, Germany&quot; is not. To be able to include the POI name, use
 <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-textquery" title="class in com.here.sdk.search"><code>TextQuery</code></a> instead. <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-searchoptions#languageCode"><code>SearchOptions.languageCode</code></a> specifies the language of the
 <a href="#query"><code>query</code></a> and determines the preferred language of the results.</div>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
